% Checks cases a fix must not break: a \thechapter set in the preamble of a
% book that prints a number at counter 0. The front-matter and back-matter
% chapters stay unnumbered, in their headings, in the table of contents,
% and in references to them.
\documentclass{book}
\renewcommand\thechapter{\arabic{chapter}}
\begin{document}
\frontmatter
\chapter{Preface}\label{preface}
Front text.
\tableofcontents
\mainmatter
\chapter{Start}\label{start}
\section{Basics}\label{basics}
Ref: \ref{start}; \ref{basics}.
\backmatter
\chapter{Afterword}\label{afterword}
Back text.

Ref: \ref{preface}; \ref{afterword}.
\end{document}
